name: Convex-Treelike Classes Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
statement: Every cover-recursively peripheral partial cube has a corner peeling, but the pentagonal obstruction is corner-peelable and not cover-recursively peripheral.
proof: Inductively concatenate prefix-isometric orders of the contraction base and duplicated site. This yields a prefix-isometric order, hence a reverse corner peeling. The pentagonal family is ample of VC dimension two and therefore corner-peelable, but every coordinate is nonperipheral.
